title: 第598章 裂风第597章 得图
content_zh:
洞窟内的血腥气与灵力波动，很快便被矿脉深处源源不断涌出的森寒气流冲淡，最终只余下满地狼藉的斗法痕迹和两具逐渐冰冷僵硬的尸身，见证着方才那场交锋。许星遥将新得的战利品收起后，没有立刻离开，并未立刻离开这片是非之地。
一来，这处矿脉短时间内应当不会有人再来，相对安全，他打算就地恢复一番。二来，刚刚得知了道宗的阴谋，还有份玉简地图，他需要时间重新规划接下来的行动。
许星遥寻了一处被巨大冰笋遮挡的角落，盘膝坐下，开始调息。约莫一个时辰后，他缓缓睁开了双眼，眸中湛蓝神光一闪而逝。他空旷的洞窟中最后扫视一圈，确认再无遗漏，身形一闪，已如一道轻烟般掠出矿脉通道，重新回到了那片风雪漫天的冰原之上。
辨认了一下方向，许星遥按照那枚青色玉简中地图的指引，选择了一条新的路径，向着秘境更深处行进。转眼，便是半个月的时间过去。
这份地图虽然并不完整，许多区域只是粗略勾勒，甚至大片空白，但其上标注的已探索区域，却提供了极为宝贵的信息。哪些冰谷是相对安全的休憩点，哪些冰川裂缝中盘踞着强大的妖兽族群，，哪些看似平静的雪原之下隐藏着致命的“冰陷流沙”……
这些信息，让许星遥避开了大量不必要的麻烦和潜在的致命危险，探索效率和安全程度都大大提升。
当然，地图并非万能。玄冰寒渊秘境广大无边，环境恶劣，妖兽横行，修士彼此厮杀，变数无处不在。。
他曾按照地图标注，前往一处据说有“冰魄玉晶”零星出产的隐秘裂谷。可当他耗费一番功夫潜入裂谷深处时，非但没有找到半块玉晶，反而惊动了一群暴躁嗜血的“霜刃血蝠”。
那群妖蝠修为全都在二阶以上，而且数量成百上千，飞行迅疾。许星遥被围，不得不全力催动冰剑，施展出层层叠叠的冰晶剑莲旋转绞杀，且战且退。最终耗费了小半灵力，用掉了两张三阶的“冰爆符”，才在蝠群中杀出一条血路，狼狈地逃离了那片裂谷，身上还被几只妖蝠留下了几道深可见骨的伤口，沾染了血煞之气，费了好一番功夫才驱除干净。
他也曾在地图标注的一处“相对安全”的冰湖边，遭遇了意料之外的袭击。一头潜伏在数十丈厚湖冰之下的三阶中期“玄冥鳄”突然破冰而出。
这头妖兽不仅力大无穷，皮糙肉厚到令人发指，其天赋神通“玄冥吐息”更是阴寒无比，竟然比许星遥最开始遇到的那头三阶后期妖龟还要难缠。
一场恶战下来，他动用了不少底牌，才找到机会，将冰剑从其眼窝贯入，绞碎了脑髓，艰难将其斩杀。不过，这头玄冥鳄的妖丹、那身防御惊人的鳄皮、以及坚韧的筋骨，价值极高，算是对他此次遇险的丰厚回报，尤其是其妖丹，蕴含精纯的玄冥寒气，对他大有用处。
除了防不胜防的凶悍妖兽，更危险的，则永远是人心。这半个月里，许星遥又遭遇了三拨修士。
第一拨是两名结伴而行的修士，修为都在玄根四层。双方在一条仅容两人通过的狭窄冰道中不期而遇。那两人见许星遥孤身一人，虽然眼中闪过毫不掩饰的贪婪之色，但或许是被许星遥的周身气势所慑，双方只是警惕地对峙了片刻，互相戒备着缓缓错身而过，最终各自退开，并未爆发冲突。
第二拨则是一名玄根五层的修士，极其擅长隐匿和刺杀之道。在许星遥途径一片冰凌林时，此人突然暴起偷袭。他手段阴狠，用的是一对细长黝黑、淬有剧毒的“无影刺”，身法更是飘忽诡异，几乎融入了周围的光影和寒气之中。
许星遥一时不察，灵觉预警稍迟半分，便被一道毒刺划破法袍，皮肤感受到刺骨的麻痹。惊怒之下，许星遥手中寒髓剑镜光芒大放，不仅护住周身，更将方圆数丈内的寒气骤然凝聚，勉强捕捉到对方一丝残影。
他毫不犹豫，冰剑出鞘，以神念锁定那丝波动，一道凝练的剑虹如同雷霆般斩出。那修士没料到许星遥反应如此迅疾，反击如此凌厉，猝不及防下，护身灵光被一剑斩破，肩胛骨被洞穿。许星遥得势不饶人，冰剑再展，最终将这名刺客斩杀。从其身上，许星遥搜出了一小袋颇为罕见的“霜骨毒砂”和几件精巧歹毒的暗器。
第三拨，则让许星遥的眼神彻底冷了下来。那是三名修为在玄根五到六层的修士，彼此间配合颇为默契。他们并非偷袭，而是堂而皇之地在许星遥途经一处冰谷时拦住了去路。
许星遥心知无法善了，假意露出惊慌之色，与三人虚与委蛇。趁对方以为吃定他，心神稍有松懈的刹那，许星遥骤然发难。他先是催动玉埙，发出直透神魂的尖锐悲鸣，同时冰剑直取其中修为最弱的那名玄根五层修士。对方猝不及防，被埙声所扰，反应慢了半拍，护体灵光被冰剑轻易撕裂，胸口被洞穿一个血洞，寒气爆发，瞬间重创倒地。
另外两人惊怒交加，厉喝着合击而来，一人祭出长刀，一人操控着三枚金光闪闪的飞梭，攻势凌厉。许星遥不闪不避，以寒镜硬抗了长刀一击，身形借力急退，同时左手掐诀，对着操控飞梭的修士遥遥一点，瞬间将其周围寒气凝聚，暂时冰封住了其身形。

就这瞬息之间，许星遥就已贴近了使刀的修士，近身搏杀！冰剑与长刀交击，短短数招，便一剑削断了对方持刀的手腕，随即剑光掠过咽喉。
那名被冰封术稍稍困住的修士刚刚挣脱，便见两名同伴一死一重伤，肝胆俱裂，转身欲逃。许星遥岂能容他走脱？冰剑脱手飞出，从其背心贯入，了结了其性命。这一战以一敌三，最为凶险，但收获也最大，三人的储物袋中，有一些不错的灵材和丹药。
半个月的探索与厮杀，让许星遥对玄冰寒渊的环境更加适应，体内灵力在那随时随地的玄冰煞气淬炼下，变得更加凝练。
content_en:
The bloody smell and spiritual power fluctuations in the cave were soon diluted by the cold air flowing out from the depths of the mines. In the end, only the messy traces of fighting skills and two corpses that gradually became cold and stiff were left, witnessing the confrontation just now. After Xu Xingyao put away his new trophies, he did not leave immediately, nor did he leave this land of right and wrong immediately.
First of all, no one should come to this mine in a short time. It is relatively safe. He plans to restore it on the spot. Secondly, he had just learned about Daozong's conspiracy and the jade slip map. He needed time to re-plan his next actions.
Xu Xingyuan found a corner covered by huge ice bamboo shoots, sat down cross-legged, and began to adjust his breathing. About an hour later, he slowly opened his eyes, and the blue light flashed in his eyes. He glanced around the empty cave for the last time to make sure that nothing was missing. In a flash, he swept out of the mine channel like a wisp of light smoke and returned to the snow-covered ice field.
After identifying the direction, Xu Xingyao followed the guidance of the map in the blue jade slip and chose a new path, heading deeper into the secret realm. In the blink of an eye, half a month passed.
Although this map is not complete, with many areas only roughly outlined and even large areas blank, the explored areas marked on it provide extremely valuable information. Which ice valleys are relatively safe resting spots, which glacier crevices are home to powerful groups of monster beasts, and which seemingly calm snowfields hide deadly "ice trap quicksand"...
This information allowed Xu Xingyao to avoid a lot of unnecessary troubles and potential fatal dangers, and his exploration efficiency and safety were greatly improved.
Of course, maps are not everything. The secret realm of Xuan Bing Han Abyss is vast and boundless, the environment is harsh, monsters are rampant, monks are fighting each other, and variables are everywhere. .
He once followed the map markings and went to a hidden rift valley where "Ice Soul Jade Crystal" was said to be produced sporadically. But when he spent a lot of effort to sneak into the depths of the rift valley, not only did he not find half of the jade crystal, but he alerted a group of violent and bloodthirsty "Frost Blade Blood Bats".
The group of monster bats were all above the second level in cultivation, and they numbered in hundreds or even thousands and flew very fast. Xu Xingyao was surrounded and had to activate the ice sword with all his strength, using layers of ice crystal sword lotus to spin and strangle, while fighting and retreating. In the end, he spent less than half his spiritual power and two third-level "Ice Explosion Talismans" to carve a bloody path among the bats, and escaped from the rift in embarrassment. Several monster bats left several bone-deep wounds on his body, which were contaminated with the blood evil energy. It took a lot of effort to drive them away.
He also encountered an unexpected attack at a "relatively safe" glacial lake marked on the map. A mid-level third-order "Xuanming Crocodile" lurking under dozens of feet of lake ice suddenly broke out of the ice.
Not only was this demonic beast extremely powerful, but its skin and flesh were outrageously thick, its innate magical power "Xuanming Breath" was even more sinister and cold, and it was even more difficult to deal with than the late third-order demon turtle that Xu Xingyao first encountered.
After a fierce battle, he used many trump cards before he found an opportunity to penetrate the ice sword through his eye socket, minced his brain, and killed him with difficulty. However, the demon elixir of this Xuanming crocodile, the crocodile skin with astonishing defense, and the tough muscles and bones were extremely valuable and could be regarded as a rich reward for his danger. Especially its demon elixir contained pure Xuanming cold energy, which was of great use to him.
In addition to the ferocious monsters that are difficult to guard against, the most dangerous thing is always the human heart. In the past half month, Xu Xingyao encountered three groups of monks.
The first group was two monks traveling together, both of whom were at the fourth level of Xuangen. The two sides met unexpectedly in a narrow ice channel that only allowed two people to pass. When the two people saw Xu Xingyao alone, although there was undisguised greed in their eyes, perhaps they were intimidated by Xu Xingyao's aura. The two sides just faced off vigilantly for a moment, wary of each other and slowly passed each other., finally retreated, and no conflict broke out.
The second group is a monk at the fifth level of Xuangen, who is extremely good at concealment and assassination. When Xu Xingyao was passing through an ice forest, this person suddenly made a sneak attack. His methods were vicious, using a pair of slender, dark, and highly poisonous "Shadowless Thorns", and his movement was even more erratic and strange, almost blending into the surrounding light, shadow and cold air.
Xu Xingyao didn't pay attention for a moment, and half a minute after his spiritual warning, he was pierced by a poisonous thorn in his robe, and his skin felt a biting numbness. In shock and anger, the cold marrow sword mirror in Xu Xingyao's hand shone brightly, not only protecting his whole body, but also suddenly condensing the cold air within a few feet, barely catching a trace of the opponent's shadow.
He did not hesitate, unsheathed the ice sword, locked on the fluctuation with his spiritual mind, and slashed out a condensed sword rainbow like thunder. The monk did not expect Xu Xingyao to react so quickly and counterattack so fiercely. He was caught off guard, his protective aura was cut through with a sword, and his shoulder blade was pierced. Xu Xingyao gained the upper hand and used his ice sword again to kill the assassin. From his body, Xu Xingyao found a small bag of rare "frost bone poisonous sand" and several exquisite and vicious hidden weapons.
The third wave made Xu Xingyao's eyes completely cold. They were three monks whose cultivation was at the fifth or sixth level of the Mysterious Root. They cooperated with each other quite well. They did not attack by surprise, but openly blocked Xu Xingyao's way when he passed an ice valley.
Xu Xingyao knew that there was nothing he could do, so he pretended to be panicked and made false concessions to the three of them. When the other party thought he was defeated and relaxed a little, Xu Xingyao suddenly attacked. He first activated the jade xun, emitting a sharp cry that penetrated the soul. At the same time, he took the ice sword directly at the fifth-level mysterious monk with the weakest cultivation level. The opponent was caught off guard, disturbed by the sound of the xun, and his reaction was half a beat too slow. The protective aura was easily torn apart by the ice sword, and a bloody hole was pierced in his chest. The cold air exploded, and he fell to the ground with severe injuries.
The other two people were frightened and angry, shouting fiercely and attacking together. One of them used a long knife, and the other controlled three shining golden shuttles, attacking fiercely. Xu Xingyao did not dodge, but used his cold mirror to resist the blow of the long sword, and used the force to retreat quickly. At the same time, he made a gesture with his left hand and moved a little away from the monk controlling the shuttle, instantly condensing the cold air around him and temporarily freezing his figure.
In just an instant, Xu Xingyao was close to the sword-wielding monk, fighting at close quarters! The ice sword and the long knife clashed. In just a few moves, the sword cut off the opponent's wrist holding the knife, and then the sword light passed across his throat.
The monk who was slightly trapped by the ice spell had just broken free when he saw that one of his two companions was dead and the other was seriously injured. He turned around and tried to escape. How could Xu Xingyao let him get away? The ice sword flew out of his hand and penetrated his vest, killing him. This battle, with one against three, was the most dangerous, but also the most rewarding. There were some good spiritual materials and elixirs in the storage bags of the three of them.
Half a month of exploration and fighting made Xu Xingyao more adaptable to the environment of the Black Ice Abyss, and his spiritual power became more condensed under the tempering of the evil energy of the Black Ice anytime and anywhere.
